pack.name: Hearthwind
pack.summary: Hearthwind - a medieval-realism survival pack for modern Minecraft (26.x era); grown from the Aged fork

_readme: Single source of truth for pack versions. To target a new release or snapshot:

targets.notes: Set minecraft to any release or snapshot id, e.g. 26.3-snapshot-9. resolve_deps.py reports per-mod readiness for that exact id.

datapack._source: versions/<mc>/server-<mc>.jar -> version.json -> pack_version.data_major (26.2 = 107, minor 1). Re-verify after every MC bump: unzip -p versions/<mc>/server-<mc>.jar version.json
